persona.syn_BI_text: I think I'll keep using this phone for a while. The AI features like the personal assistant and camera enhancement are pretty handy, especially for studying and social media. And the smooth performance is good for my daily tasks. Even though it's not as fancy as my last phone, it feels like it has enough power and AI features to meet my needs without breaking the bank.

This phone has been really helpful for my photography and videos, and the AI camera enhancement is a game-changer. The smooth performance and on-device AI processing also make it easy to use without worrying about data privacy. But at ₹24,999, I'm not sure if the extra cost is worth it, considering I usually replace my phone every 3-4 years. I might keep it for now, but I'll probably go for something less expensive next time.

This phone is pretty handy for gaming and study, and the AI features are cool, but I'm not sure if it's worth the price. It stops working sometimes, and I've been there before where my previous phone just stopped working. The battery optimization sounds good, but I don't want to replace it too often.

This phone seems a bit pricey for what I need, but the AI features like the personal assistant and camera enhancement could be handy. I mainly use my phone for social media and studying, so the smooth performance and simple interface might work well for me. Still, I'm not sure if the price is worth it for me.
